name: Red Stingray 60
author: bhaveshxrawat
description: Rounded sky-blue button that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background changes from #fff to #F6F9FE, text color changes from #3c4043 to #174ea6.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Red Stingray 60</title>
<style>
/* Red Stingray 60 by bhaveshxrawat — https://uiverse.io/bhaveshxrawat/red-stingray-60 */
button {
 background-color: #fff;
 border-radius: 24px;
 border-style: none;
 box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, .2) 0 3px 5px -1px,rgba(0, 0, 0, .14) 0 6px 10px 0,rgba(0, 0, 0, .12) 0 1px 18px 0;
 box-sizing: border-box;
 color: #3c4043;
 font-size: 14px;
 font-weight: 500;
 font-family: inherit;
 letter-spacing: .25px;
 line-height: normal;
 padding: 11px 24px;
 transition: background box-shadow 280ms ease;
}

button:hover {
 background: #F6F9FE;
 color: #174ea6;
}

button:active {
 box-shadow: 0 4px 4px 0 rgb(60 64 67 / 30%), 0 8px 12px 6px rgb(60 64 67 / 15%);
 outline: none;
 border: 2px solid #4285f4;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button> Grab it!
</button>

</body>
</html>
